description:
Add a complete Retrofit networking layer to the PostViewer Android project. The project is a basic empty app. You need to:

1. Add the following dependencies to `app/build.gradle.kts`:
   - Retrofit (com.squareup.retrofit2:retrofit:2.9.0)
   - Moshi Converter (com.squareup.retrofit2:converter-moshi:2.9.0)
   - Moshi Kotlin (com.squareup.moshi:moshi-kotlin:1.15.0)
   - OkHttp Logging Interceptor (com.squareup.okhttp3:logging-interceptor:4.12.0)
   - Kotlin Coroutines Android (org.jetbrains.kotlinx:kotlinx-coroutines-android:1.7.3)

2. Add the `<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET" />` to `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`.

3. Create a data model `app/src/main/java/com/example/postviewer/model/Post.kt`:
   - Data class `Post` with fields: `id: Int`, `userId: Int`, `title: String`, `body: String`.
   - Annotate the class with `@JsonClass(generateAdapter = true)`.

4. Create an API interface `app/src/main/java/com/example/postviewer/network/PostApiService.kt`:
   - `suspend fun getPosts(): List<Post>` (@GET("posts"))
   - `suspend fun getPost(@Path("id") id: Int): Post` (@GET("posts/{id}"))
   - `suspend fun getPostsByUser(@Query("userId") userId: Int): List<Post>` (@GET("posts"))

5. Create a singleton `app/src/main/java/com/example/postviewer/network/ApiClient.kt`:
   - Object `ApiClient`.
   - Base URL: `https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/`
   - Configured with `HttpLoggingInterceptor` (Level.BODY).
   - Expose `val postApiService: PostApiService`.

6. Ensure the project builds successfully (Gradle Sync and Build).
